title: Dirty Kitchen by Jill Damatac
description:
Novels and Nibbles is blending Filipino recipes, family traditions, laughter, and personal resilience with fried SPAM. Jill Damatac’s memoir recounts her childhood after emigrating from the Philippines to America where her family lived undocumented for two decades enduring poverty, domestic violence and fear of deportation. SPAM is a beloved comfort food shaped by American influence in the Filipino kitchen. It represents the author’s complicated feelings she has about America. What are all of these feelings? Well, you have to read it to find out!!

We are serving up Spamsilog....a Filipino FAV!  Don’t knock it till you’ve tried it! Crispy golden SPAM served alongside fragrant jasmine rice sautéed with garlic and topped with two eggs cooked just how you like them. This dish is finished with a sprinkling of parsley for beauty and taste. 

One bite and you’ll discover why an entire memoir was inspired by the magic of SPAM and eggs!
